2608.24103.title: ACE: A Self-Correcting Agentic Canvas Editor for Multi-Slide Presentation Automation
2608.24103.paper_summary: Commercial design platforms increasingly edit documents through large language model (LLM) agents, but two practical problems block reliable deployment: legacy document formats expose only \emph{flat}, absolutely positioned elements, so agents must recompute coordinates and routinely break layouts; and design has no unique ground truth, so diff-against-reference metrics penalize valid-but-different outputs. We present \textbf{ACE}, an agentic canvas editor over a \emph{hierarchical scene-graph} with a presentation-specialized action space (98 tools), paired with \textbf{CARE}, a content-aware router that feeds the agent only the relevant slice of each deck (avg.\ $\sim$89\% input-token reduction), and a \emph{self-correction} loop driven by a \emph{ground-truth-free} instruction-following (IF) judge whose natural-language critique is fed back as the next-turn instruction. With a fixed backbone, a scene-graph editor in a \emph{single turn} already matches a same-backbone \emph{agentic} HTML pipeline that iterates internally; adding self-correction lifts ACE significantly above it on instruction following (IF 4.23 vs.\ 3.81 on the full 94-task benchmark, paired $p{=}.010$, replicated by an out-of-loop judge) at 1.75$\times$ the speed and $\sim$44\% lower cost. VQ means are statistically indistinguishable, but 26 blind raters prefer ACE overall (58.7\% decisive win-rate) and prefer the self-corrected output 81\% of the time; the ranking is invariant across three judge families, and out-of-loop judges retain two-thirds of the self-correction gain, bounding circularity. 66\% of cases halt after one pass, and a strict-peak rollback removes every observed regression.
2608.24103.paper_summary_zh: 商業設計平台越來越多地通過大型語言模型（LLM）代理編輯文檔，但有兩個實際問題阻礙了可靠的部署：舊版文檔格式僅顯示\emph{平面}、絕對定位的元素，因此代理必須重新計算坐標並經常破壞佈局；而設計沒有唯一的真實基準，因此與參考的差異度量會懲罰有效但不同的輸出。我們提出了\textbf{ACE}，一個基於\emph{層次場景圖}的代理畫布編輯器，具有專為展示設計的動作空間（98個工具），並配合\textbf{CARE}，一個內容感知路由器，僅向代理提供每個甲板的相關片段（平均約\ $\sim$89\%的輸入標記減少），以及一個由\emph{無基準真實}的指令跟隨（IF）評判驅動的\emph{自我修正}迴圈，其自然語言批評作為下一步的指令反饋。使用固定的骨幹，在\emph{單次回合}中的場景圖編輯器已經與同一骨幹的\emph{代理} HTML管道相匹配，該管道在內部進行迭代；添加自我修正使ACE在指令跟隨方面顯著超過它（IF 4.23對3.81，基於完整的94任務基準，配對$p{=}.010$，由一個非迴圈評判複製）以1.75$\times$的速度和約44\%的成本降低。VQ均值在統計上無法區分，但26名盲評者整體上偏好ACE（58.7\%的決定性勝率），並在81\%的時間內偏好自我修正的輸出；該排名在三個評判家族中保持不變，非迴圈評判保留了三分之二的自我修正增益，限制了循環性。66\%的案例在一次通過後停止，嚴格的峰值回滾移除了每一個觀察到的回歸。
